purpose: Verify employee can view accurate entitlement and current balance for all applicable leave categories
expected_result: 200 OK with correct credited, availed, and available balances

purpose: Verify leave balance cannot become negative through regular leave deduction
expected_result: Validation fails, balance remains non-negative

purpose: Verify employee can create and submit leave application with dates, category, and purpose
expected_result: 201 Created with application record and initial state

purpose: Verify station leave details are coupled inside the application and do not create separate lifecycle
action_or_input: Submit application with station_leave fields populated
expected_result: Station leave stored in the same application record without separate lifecycle ID

purpose: Verify application checks employee category eligibility against configured policy
action_or_input: Submit application with invalid category for role
expected_result: 422 Unprocessable Entity returned with category eligibility error

purpose: Verify system verifies sufficient entitlement before submission progresses
expected_result: 422 Unprocessable Entity returned with insufficient balance message

purpose: Verify accurate calculation of chargeable days based on counting rule and calendar
action_or_input: Request CL vs EL duration calculation
expected_result: CL excludes weekends/holidays; EL includes continuous days

purpose: Verify system detects and blocks impermissible overlap with active leave
preconditions: Employee has active approved or pending leave
action_or_input: Submit application with overlapping date range
expected_result: 422 Unprocessable Entity rejecting overlapping application

purpose: Verify first-half and second-half CL on the same date are not considered overlapping
preconditions: First-half CL already approved for date
action_or_input: Apply for second-half CL on same date
expected_result: Application permitted and accepted without collision error

purpose: Verify CL credited annually and unavailed days lapse at calendar year end
action_or_input: Run year-end processing on CL balance
expected_result: CL balance resets; zero carry forward

purpose: Verify RH can only be availed on published RH calendar dates up to annual cap (2 days)
preconditions: Published RH calendar; employee has taken 1 RH day
action_or_input: Apply for 2nd RH day on published date
expected_result: Accepted; subsequent 3rd RH application rejected

purpose: Verify Special Casual Leave capped at 15 days for academic/official conferences and duties
action_or_input: Apply for SCL within quota with valid academic purpose
expected_result: Accepted for processing; balance debited upon approval

purpose: Verify EL accumulates up to maximum limit of 300 days across calendar years
preconditions: Employee has 295 days EL; 15 days credit triggered
expected_result: Balance reaches 300 days maximum; additional days capped

purpose: Verify faculty VL restricted to vacation periods and unavailed days convert to EL at 2:1 ratio
preconditions: Faculty with unavailed VL at year end
expected_result: VL converted to EL at 2:1 ratio subject to 300 cap

purpose: Verify Commuted Leave debits 2x days from HPL and mandates medical certificate
action_or_input: Apply for 4 days COL with certificate attached
expected_result: Accepted and 8 days deducted from entitlement

purpose: Verify nomination of an active, eligible substitute employee
expected_result: Substitute validated, request set to PENDING_SUBSTITUTE

purpose: Verify self-nomination as substitute is rejected
preconditions: Applicant specifies their own employee ID as substitute
expected_result: 422 Unprocessable Entity

purpose: Verify substitute must consent before request moves to Unit Head review
expected_result: Status advances to PENDING_APPROVAL; assigned to Unit Head

purpose: Verify substitute decline allows applicant to nominate replacement
expected_result: Substitute marked DECLINED; applicant permitted to re-nominate

purpose: Verify Unit Head is final sanctioning authority for CL and RH
expected_result: Status transitions to SANCTIONED/APPROVED directly

purpose: Verify Unit Head review of EL/COL/VL/SCL routes to higher sanctioning authority
expected_result: Status transitions to PENDING_HIGHER_SANCTION

purpose: Verify higher authority (Dean/Director) sanctions recommended leave
expected_result: Status transitions to SANCTIONED; balance debited

purpose: Verify Director leave applications are self-sanctioned without subordinate approval
expected_result: Application immediately transitions to SANCTIONED

purpose: Verify applicant can immediately withdraw pending leave prior to sanctioning
expected_result: Status set to WITHDRAWN; balance hold released

purpose: Verify approved leave cancellation submitted before start date and approved by sanctioning authority
expected_result: Status transitions to CANCELLED and leave balance restored

purpose: Verify extension of ongoing EL/COL/VL requested before end date
action_or_input: Submit extension request with extended end date
expected_result: Extension created and routed for approval

purpose: Verify duty resumption submission upon return from leave and Unit Head approval
action_or_input: Submit resumption; Unit Head verifies and approves
expected_result: Resumption approved and leave closed (with balance adjustment if early)

purpose: Verify admin can record paper-sanctioned offline leave into system ledger
action_or_input: POST offline sanction record with approver and paper order reference
expected_result: 201 Created; balance debited and history logged

purpose: Verify Admin can maintain calendar dates and academic vacation periods
expected_result: 200 OK and vacation period saved

purpose: Verify SLA scheduled task checks pending tasks and logs reminders/escalations
preconditions: Tasks pending longer than threshold hours
expected_result: SLA reminders/escalations generated in audit history

purpose: Verify retrieval of printable application format with complete authorization details
expected_result: 200 OK with formatted printable details

purpose: Verify users can only access endpoints permitted for their assigned roles and permissions
action_or_input: Attempt to access admin offline leave sync endpoint
expected_result: 403 Forbidden
